description: Agent1Q is designed to perform targeted extractions from web and PDF sources, analyze attached Excel files for counts and comparisons, and cross-verify multi-paper overlaps or census splits. It delivers formatted results according to specified units, orders, and exclusions, ensuring accuracy and relevance in its outputs.

tools.name: SearchTool

tools.description: Extracts specific data points from PDF documents, such as volumes, mentions, and settings.

tools.name: ExcelAnalyzer
tools.description: Analyzes Excel files for counts and comparisons, such as book availability and accommodation suitability.

tools.name: DataComparer
tools.description: Compares datasets to identify overlaps or differences, particularly in multi-paper contexts.
